scientific_integrity: All asserted infinite-time claims are supported by written mathematical reductions and standard explicitly identified probabilistic theorems; finite numerical checks provide only reproducibility support. Bibliographic completeness and independent audit are not claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact full Newton on unbounded positive-definite homogeneous quadratics, iid isotropic Gaussian perturbations and deterministic nonzero starting state only. It does not cover approximate Hessians, toroidal dynamics, general nonconvex objectives or mean-square stability in regimes with differing almost-sure behavior.
title: Spectral anisotropy reverses critical-noise stability of Gaussian randomized Newton
